scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TEKH_DATA=demo npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: node -e "console.error('Use npm run dev (local demo data) or npm run start:prod (live JSON).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production TEKH_DATA=live npm run start --prefix server
